Additional RoE may be allowed if any element of the transmission project is completed within the specified timeline and it is certified by the regional Power Committee/National Power Committee that commissioning of the particular element will benefit the system operation in the regional/national grid 29. The petitioner has claimed additional RoE of 0.5% for commissioning the instant line within the timeline specified in the 2014 Tariff Regulations. It is observed that part of the project i.e., 2 x 240 MVar switchable Line Reactors is yet to be commissioned. As per Regulation 24(2) of the 2014 Tariff Regulations, additional RoE is to be allowed only if the project as a whole has been commissioned within the timeline specified in Appendix-I of the 2014 Tariff Regulations, but with an exception vide Regulation 24(2)(iii) which specifies that it can be considered in a case wherein it has been certified by RPC/NPC that the element of a project completed within the time specified will benefit the system operation in the regional/national grid. However, the certificate submitted by the petitioner does not clearly state that the element will benefit the system and further the entire project is yet to achieve COD and hence we are not inclined to allow the petitioner‟s claim for additional RoE. 31.
